store_sale_errors.name: store_sale_errors
store_sale_errors.description: Store sales that were voided: the reliability signal store managers act on

definition.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN m.SS_IS_VOID = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

dimensions.name: store
dimensions.description: The store the sale belongs to.

dimensions.name: seasonal
dimensions.sql: CASE WHEN t1.I_ITEM_TAGS LIKE '%Seasonal%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
dimensions.description: Whether the item is tagged seasonal.

examples.question: How are voided sales trending month by month per store, broken down by channel and whether the item is seasonal?
examples.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', SS_SOLD_TIMESTAMP) AS month, SS_STORE_SK, SUM(CASE WHEN SS_IS_VOID = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_SALES GROUP BY 1, 2

definition.population: Store sales, one row per sale, attributed to the store and carrying the channel and item tags
